Dear [Miss Atkinson](../persons.html#70),
I sent on your Robin and I think we are grateful for it

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Blanche Atkinson was an associate of Frances Power Cobbe and Ruskin and a keen naturalist who contributed to MP in 1893, but this letter may not be to her, and the \'Robin\' cannot be identified.
